result:
This is Zed. Big workspace, no single crate.

**Scale:** 236 crates, ~1.33M lines Rust, plus `extensions/` (bundled extensions) and `docs/`.

**Main pieces:**

- **`gpui`** — own UI/app framework (retained-mode elements, entities, async contexts). Split into platform backends: `gpui_macos`, `gpui_linux`, `gpui_windows`, `gpui_web`, `gpui_wgpu`, `gpui_tokio`.
- **`editor`, `multi_buffer`, `rope`, `text`, `language`, `language_core`** — text/buffer engine + language support core.
- **`lsp`, `dap`, `dap_adapters`** — language server + debug adapter protocol clients.
- **`project`, `worktree`, `fs`, `remote`, `remote_server`, `remote_connection`** — project model, filesystem abstraction, remote dev (SSH host/guest split).
- **`workspace`, `ui`, `theme`, `settings`, `settings_ui`** — app shell, design system, config.
- **`agent`, `agent_ui`, `agent_servers`, `acp_thread`, `agent_skills`, `context_server`** — AI agent panel + Agent Client Protocol.
- **Model providers as own crates:** `anthropic`, `open_ai`, `google_ai`, `bedrock`, `ollama`, `deepseek`, `mistral`, `x_ai`, `open_router`, `copilot`, `copilot_chat`, `lmstudio`, `codestral` — plus `language_model`/`language_models` abstraction layer.
- **`edit_prediction*` crates** — Zeta/edit-prediction feature, split into context, types, metrics, cli, ui.
- **`vim`** — vim mode.
- **`collab`, `collab_ui`, `rpc`, `proto`, `channel`, `call`** — Zed's collab server + client protocol (this is the one server-side crate, deployed separately).
- **`git`, `git_ui`, `git_hosting_providers`, `git_graph`** — git integration.
- **`terminal`, `terminal_view`** — embedded terminal.
- **`extension`, `extension_host`, `extension_api`, `extension_cli`** — extension system.
- **`zed`** — top crate that wires everything into the actual app binary; `cli` is the `zed` CLI launcher.

Workspace resolver "2", single `Cargo.lock`, all crates versioned together.
